The '''Dooku's throne room''', also known as '''Dooku's chambers''',<ref name="Nightsisters Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/nightsisters-episode-guide|text="Nightsisters" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> was a throne room of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], located in the main tower of [[Dooku's palace/Legends|his]] [[palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. A huge chamber with a high ceiling, it contained the [[Count/Legends|Count's]] formal [[Throne/Legends|throne]] and desk, which were placed on a raised dais at the far end of the room. On the back of the throne stood a stained glass [[Window/Legends|window]] through which the sunlight bathed the room with a [[Color/Legends|greenish]] glow.<ref name="Nightsisters" /> That vast window was as high as twelve [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stacked one on top of another,<ref name="Box">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-box-concept-art-gallery|text="The Box" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|slide 4}}</ref> which was around 22 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Height">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] all measured 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The height of the window is obtained by multiplying that of a standard clone trooper by twelve, which gives 21.96 meters.</ref> The throne chamber was directly connected to the Count's [[Dooku's sleeping chamber/Legends|sleeping chamber]] by a gangway.<ref name="Nightsisters" />
